mainLayoutCtrl2.text: Syftehjälp för denna kontroll på operatörskonsolen.

mainLayoutCtrl3.text: Syftehjälp för denna kontroll på operatörskonsolen.

open_source_credits.text: Listar tredjepartskomponenter med öppen källkod som används av denna produkt.

application_groups.text: Grupper som binder program till elevations- och åtkomstpolicy.

who_may_elevate.text: Principaler som får begära eller ta emot elevation för bundna program.

elevation_approvals.text: Väntande och slutförda godkännanden för elevationsbegäranden.

actionLogout.text: Avslutar den inloggade sessionen i den här webbläsaren och återgår till inloggningssidan.

actionEdit.text: Öppnar redigeraren för den här raden.

actionSave.text: Sparar de aktuella ändringarna på servern.

actionCreate.text: Öppnar formuläret för att skapa ett nytt objekt.

actionClearFilter.text: Rensar det aktiva listfiltret och visar alla rader igen.

actionDelete.text: Tar bort objektet permanent efter bekräftelse. Revisionhistoriken kan behålla tidigare händelser.

licensingActivate.text: Startar en kort guide: kopiera platstoken, aktivera på licenshanteringswebbplatsen och importera det signerade paketet.

actionImport.text: Importerar en fil eller ett paket till det här området.

actionMore.text: Öppnar fler åtgärder för den här raden.

actionDetails.text: Öppnar detaljvyn för det här objektet.

tenantDisplayName.text: Human-readable label for this organization. Becomes permanent after create; agents reference the multi-tenant by GUID, not this name.

tenantAuthPolicy.text: How offline agents authenticate to this multi-tenant. Only HMAC is supported today; the server validates request signatures with the bootstrap secret.

identityId.text: Stable identifier for this managed account on the endpoint. Use a GUID or short unique name; cannot change after create.

accountBinding.text: Explicit: you name the local account (Administrator, root). Well-known: the agent maps a catalog key to the correct account for the OS.

wellKnownAccount.text: Catalog entry the agent resolves at runtime (e.g. Windows built-in Administrator). Pick the platform-appropriate key.

accountName.text: Exact local account name on the endpoint OS. Must match what the agent will rotate (Administrator, root, svc-backup, etc.).

identityDescription.text: Optional note for operators (purpose, owner, ticket). Not sent to the agent as a secret.

rotationStartOffset.text: Delay from secret minting time before this identity’s first rotation (DD:HH:MM:SS). Staggers password changes within a group.

rotationOffsetDays.text: Days to delay this identity’s first rotation after the anchor, so identities in a group do not all rotate at once.

rotationOffsetHours.text: Additional hours on top of rotation offset days (0–23). Combined delay staggers password changes.

rotationOffsetMinutes.text: Additional minutes on top of rotation offset days and hours (0–59). Combined delay staggers password changes.

machineName.text: Hostname or label reported by the agent. Used in lists and elevation; should match what operators recognize.

macAddress.text: Hardware MAC the agent presents at registration. Format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF or with hyphens.

ipAddress.text: Last known IPv4 or IPv6 address for this endpoint. Used for display and connectivity hints.

platformType.text: Operating system family. Drives well-known account catalog and agent behavior.

tenantName.text: Multi-Tenant display name this endpoint belongs to. Must match a multi-tenant created under Multi-Tenancy (or server default).

domainName.text: Windows or LDAP domain when the machine is domain-joined. Leave empty for standalone/workgroup hosts.

systemGroupName.text: Optional group to place the endpoint in at registration. Group policy and identity templates apply from this group.

groupName.text: Unique group key (letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores). Endpoints inherit policy and templates from their group.

groupDescription.text: Optional operator note describing who or what this group is for (production servers, lab VMs, etc.).

wizardUsageType.text: ConnectedManaged: online sync. OneShotProvisioning: single bootstrap file. AirGappedPermanent: no check-in expected.

wizardTenant.text: Multi-Tenant whose bootstrap secret and GUID are embedded in issued settings. Create a multi-tenant first if the list is empty.

wizardGroup.text: System group whose password policy, identity template, and elevation settings are copied into the issuance.

passwordLength.text: Minimum generated password length (8–128). Longer values improve strength; some legacy apps cap acceptable length.

rotationDays.text: Days until the next scheduled password rotation for identities using this policy level.

maxDriftSeconds.text: Maximum clock skew (seconds) allowed between server and agent before drift warnings appear.

secretUpdateFrequencyHours.text: How often agents poll the server for password updates when connected.

allowedSpecialChars.text: Characters permitted in generated passwords. Leave default for full ASCII symbol set unless a target app restricts symbols.

policyVersion.text: Optional label for audit trails when you change policy shape (e.g. v2-2026-q1).

caFilePath.text: CA bundle path embedded in issued settings for agents in this group. Leave empty for domain-joined machines or platform trust store.

localAccountName.text: Default local account name in generated settings (Administrator, root). Leave empty for platform defaults.

machinePolicyOverride.text: Overrides group and global defaults for this endpoint only. Every field is required — the server stores a fully resolved policy.

seedDefaultIdentity.text: When enabled, template rows are applied automatically when new endpoints join this group.

elevationTemplateEnabled.text: When enabled, settings.json issued for this group includes elevation_secret so operators can mint elevation codes.

templatePolicyInherit.text: When on, the row uses the group password policy (Edit policy). Turn off to define rules only for identities seeded from this row.

elevationEndpoint.text: Endpoint that accepts the code through the offline agent elevation channel.

elevationTargetGroup.text: OS group added during elevation. Pick from the elevation platform policy for this endpoint OS, or type a custom group name.

elevationDuration.text: Minutes the elevation stays active after activation (1–480).

elevationScheduled.text: Future activation time on the endpoint. Must be at least one minute from now.

privilegeJobEndpoint.text: Endpoint whose offline agent runs the privilege execute handler over the admin pipe.

privilegeJobMember.text: Qualified account added at activate time (for example DOMAIN\\user or a local user name).

privilegeJobTargetGroup.text: Qualified local group on the endpoint (for example BUILTIN\\Administrators on Windows).

privilegeJobDelay.text: Minutes from now until the apply step is eligible (0 = as soon as the processor claims it).

privilegeJobDuration.text: Minutes the membership stays after apply; revoke runs when this window ends.

wizardMachineDns.text: Hostname or DNS label for the single machine receiving one-shot or air-gapped settings. Pre-allocates an endpoint id.

wizardDescription.text: Optional operator note on the issuance record (ticket, owner, site).

wizardTtlHours.text: Hours until the enrollment token expires. Leave empty for the server default.

loginUsername.text: Your AIC Server account name (local IAM or federated subject). Used with your password for this logon.

loginPassword.text: Password for this account. AIC Server never shows the value; failed attempts are audited.

loginProvider.text: Which identity path to use for this logon (local password, PIV, or other configured providers).

loginTotpCode.text: Six-digit code from your authenticator app for this account. Codes expire about every 30 seconds.

loginRadiusPasscode.text: One-time passcode or response from your RADIUS token for the second step of this logon.

loginNewPassword.text: Choose a new password that meets the organization password policy shown on this page.

loginConfirmPassword.text: Type the same new password again to confirm there are no typing mistakes.

loginResetToken.text: One-time token from your password-reset email. Paste it here to set a new password.

loginWebAuthn.text: Use a security key or platform authenticator registered to this account.

principalUsername.text: Login name for this principal in local IAM. Must be unique within this server.

principalDisplayName.text: Name shown in lists and audit records. Prefer a real person name operators recognize.

principalEmail.text: Email used for reset links and notifications. Not used as the durable identity key.

principalRoles.text: Roles that grant permissions in the admin console. Least privilege: assign only what this person needs.

principalEnabled.text: When off, this principal cannot log on. Disable instead of delete to keep audit history.

sessionIdleTimeout.text: Minutes of inactivity before the console session ends. Shorter values reduce unattended console risk.

sessionAbsoluteTimeout.text: Maximum session lifetime in minutes regardless of activity. Forces periodic re-authentication.

profileRecoveryPhone.text: Optional phone in E.164 format for administrator-assisted recovery of this local account.

profileUiTheme.text: Color scheme for the whole site. Saved on this user profile so it follows you on any browser.

profileDefenseSkin.text: Color scheme for the Attack / Threat Report page only. Default follows the site scheme. Black is the dark report look.

currentPassword.text: Your current local-account password. Required to prove you own the account before changing it.

elevationJustification.text: Ticket or incident id explaining why elevation is needed. Required when sensitive-access justification policy is on.

elevationStrategy.text: How the activation code is built (alphabet, length). Must match the strategy the endpoint agent was provisioned with.

encryptedSecret.text: One-time encrypted bootstrap secret for the agent. Copy and store it securely; it is not shown again.

networkCidr.text: IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR (for example 10.0.0.0/8) that this allow or deny rule applies to.

networkRuleNote.text: Optional operator note for why this network rule exists (site, VPN pool, ticket).

threatIntelCidr.text: Network range to allow or suppress in threat-intel decisions. Use CIDR notation.

threatIntelComment.text: Operator note for this threat-intel override. Keep it short and free of secrets.

bootstrapAdminUsername.text: Username for the first local administrator created during bootstrap. Must be unique on this server.

bootstrapAdminPassword.text: Initial password for the bootstrap administrator. Change it after first logon.

bootstrapAdminEmail.text: Recovery email for the bootstrap administrator. Used for password-reset links.

idpIssuerUrl.text: OpenID Connect issuer URL. Discovery uses this to load authorize, token, and JWKS endpoints.

idpClientId.text: OAuth / OIDC client id registered with the identity provider for this server.

idpClientSecret.text: Client secret for confidential OIDC clients. Stored as a secret; never paste into tickets.

idpDisplayName.text: Label operators see when choosing this identity provider on the logon page.

adTrustDomain.text: Active Directory domain or realm this trust entry covers (for example CORP.EXAMPLE).

adTrustHost.text: Domain controller or LDAP host used to validate directory logons for this trust.

webAuthnCredentialName.text: Friendly name for this security key or platform authenticator so you can tell devices apart.

accessMapLabel.text: Short label for this access-map entry. Shown on the map and in audit lists.

mfaGraceMinutes.text: Minutes after logon before MFA is required again for this policy. Zero means every new session.

localPwMinLength.text: Minimum length for local IAM passwords under this policy.

localPwMaxAgeDays.text: Days until a local password expires. Zero turns age expiry off.

localPwMinAgeDays.text: Minimum days between local password changes. Prevents rapid recycle of history.

localPwHistoryCount.text: How many prior local passwords are remembered and cannot be reused.

totpIssuer.text: Name shown in authenticator apps for TOTP enrollment. Empty uses this server hostname.

adHomeDomain.text: Prime Active Directory DNS domain for this trust policy (for example contoso.local).

adFederatedDomains.text: Comma-separated domains allowed to log on. Elevated claims from these domains are suppressed.

adElevatedGroups.text: Group names or SIDs that confer elevated roles when asserted by the home domain only.

adEvalDomain.text: Principal domain to evaluate against the trust policy for diagnostics.

adEvalGroups.text: Comma-separated groups to evaluate for elevated mapping under the trust policy.

countryAllowList.text: Countries allowed for this geo access rule. Clear the chips to remove a country.

pivCertificatePem.text: Public leaf certificate in PEM form. Private keys are refused and never stored.

connectivityHost.text: Hostname or IP to probe for this connectivity test. Does not change saved provider settings.

connectivityPort.text: TCP port to probe for this connectivity test.

logonPolicyName.text: Name of this logon policy. Principals and roles reference it by this label.

logonPolicyValue.text: Value for this logon policy setting. Format depends on the setting key shown in the row.

ipRuleCidr.text: CIDR allowed or denied for console logon from this rule.

ipRuleComment.text: Optional note describing who or what this IP rule is for.

idpClaimFilterMode.text: How primary claims from this identity provider are filtered before role mapping.

idpRedirectUri.text: OAuth redirect URI registered with the identity provider for this server callback.

idpScopes.text: Comma-separated OIDC scopes requested at logon (for example openid profile email).

idpClaimNames.text: Comma-separated claim names used for role or group mapping from this provider.

idpTrustedIssuer.text: Issuer URL trusted for validating tokens from this identity provider.

idpTrustClaimAllowlist.text: Comma-separated claims allowed from this trusted issuer. Others are ignored.

idpKind.text: Identity provider kind (OIDC or other supported federation type).

windowsSpn.text: Kerberos service principal name used for Windows integrated authentication.

windowsMapAttribute.text: Directory attribute mapped to the local principal username.

threatIntelEditValue.text: Edited value for this threat-intel override entry.

maxmindAccountId.text: Optional MaxMind account id override for geo IP lookups on this server.

maxmindLicenseKey.text: Optional MaxMind license key override. Stored as a secret; never paste into tickets.

fourEyesPrincipalId.text: UUID of the principal who needs a second-person acknowledgment.

fourEyesManagerEmail.text: Email of the manager or second person who must acknowledge.

fourEyesHours.text: Hours until the four-eyes request expires if not acknowledged.

fourEyesAckBy.text: Identity of the second person completing the acknowledgment.

dryRunSourceIp.text: Source IP used for a dry-run access-map evaluation. Does not change live rules.

pamConnectionPointName.text: Label operators see when opening a session. Prefer the machine or service name they already know.

pamProtocol.text: Session protocol for this connection point (SSH, RDP, VNC, or OT). Must match what the target listens for.

pamHost.text: Hostname or IP the jump or proxy uses to reach the target. Must resolve from the capacity host.

pamPort.text: TCP port on the target for this protocol. Common defaults: SSH 22, RDP 3389, VNC 5900.

pamSessionAccount.text: OS account name used when the session opens. For exclusive CUI seats this is usually the assigned user’s username.

pamCredential.text: Which vaulted or managed credential supplies the password or key for this Open.

myWorkstationConnect.text: Opens an interactive session to this assigned workstation using the configured protocol and account.

myWorkstationPower.text: Starts or stops the workstation VM or container when power control is available for this seat.

myWorkstationKeepAwakeReason.text: Plain-language reason to pause auto-sleep for a long task. Audited; never enter passwords or tokens.

myWorkstationOpenSession.text: Opens the recorded session viewer for a session that Connect already authorized.

jumpFleetHost.text: Jump / session capacity host that proxies interactive sessions. Health and load affect Open success.

jumpMaxSessions.text: Maximum simultaneous sessions this capacity host should accept before the fleet balancer prefers another node.

jumpNodeDisplayName.text: Operator label for this jump / capacity node in the fleet list.

jumpNodeAddress.text: Network address operators and the control plane use to reach this capacity host.

jumpNodeWeight.text: Relative load-balancing weight for this node. Higher values attract more new sessions when healthy.

jumpDrainMode.text: When draining, this node accepts no new sessions so existing ones can finish before maintenance.

jumpAcceptingSessions.text: When checked, this node accepts new interactive sessions.

assignmentPrincipal.text: Signed-in principal who receives this workstation seat. Assignments bind the person record, not a shared token.

assignmentWorkstation.text: Workstation or connection target assigned to the principal for exclusive or shared use.

assignmentNotes.text: Optional operator note on this assignment (ticket, seat purpose). Not a secret.

pamDenyReason.text: Required reason when denying an approval. Stored in the audit trail and shown to the requester when policy allows.

pamAccessJustification.text: Why you need this access. Approvers and auditors read this text; keep it specific and non-secret.

pamAccessDuration.text: How long the approved access should last. Shorter windows reduce standing privilege.

pamAccessTicket.text: Optional ITSM or ticket ID for this access request. Helps approvers and auditors correlate.

pamCredentialConfirm.text: Re-enter the same password to confirm before it is sealed at rest.

pamRecordingMode.text: Proxy records every interactive session on the capacity host. Target-local requires endpoint attestation.

pamClipboardPolicy.text: Clipboard direction allowed for this live session, within the admin-configured I/O ceiling.

pamFileTransferPolicy.text: File transfer direction allowed for this live session, within the admin-configured I/O ceiling.

pamKeyboardLayout.text: Keyboard layout sent to the remote session for typed input.

pamSessionChatMessage.text: Message sent to other participants in this live session chat.

pamMonitorPicker.text: Which remote monitor to show when the session has more than one display.

pamCredentialUsername.text: Username stored with this connection credential. Used when the session opens.

pamCredentialSecret.text: Password or private key material for this credential. Stored sealed; reveals are audited.

remoteAccessSearch.text: Filters connection targets by name or host so you can open the one you need.

commandSetName.text: Name of this command governance set. Shown when assigning sets to targets or principals.

commandSetDescription.text: What this command set is for (baseline SSH allow list, OT deny list, etc.).

commandRulePattern.text: Pattern matched against the submitted command. Exact or glob rules depending on the set mode.

commandRuleExplanation.text: Plain-language reason this rule allows or blocks a command. Shown to operators and in audit.

commandDefaultAction.text: What happens when no rule matches: deny (allowlist) or allow (blocklist). Deny is least privilege.

commandRuleAction.text: Whether this rule allows or denies a matching command. Deny always wins when rules conflict.

commandRuleRisk.text: Optional risk label for this rule (low / medium / high). Helps operators review the set.

commandRuleOverrideable.text: When on, an approved command entitlement may override this deny for matching commands.

commandAssignmentSet.text: Command governance set to attach. Its allow and deny patterns apply in the chosen scope.

commandAssignmentScope.text: Global applies to all connection points; one-point scope limits the set to a single target.

commandEntitlementSubjectKind.text: Whether this additional-command right is granted to one principal or an IAM role.

commandEntitlementPrincipal.text: Principal who receives the additional-command entitlement.

commandEntitlementRole.text: IAM role that receives the additional-command entitlement for all members.

commandEntitlementScope.text: Whether the entitlement applies to all connection points or one named point.

commandEntitlementConnectionPoint.text: Connection point where this entitlement is in effect.

commandEntitlementCommandSet.text: Command set whose allow patterns are granted as additional rights under this entitlement.

commandEntitlementAccessKind.text: Standing stays live; JIT requires an approved time-bounded grant.

commandEntitlementMaxDuration.text: Maximum lifetime in seconds for a JIT grant under this entitlement.

commandEntitlementNotes.text: Optional operator note on why this entitlement exists. Not a secret.

commandPreviewRaw.text: Command text to canonicalize and evaluate. The server never executes it from this preview.

commandPreviewTarget.text: Optional connection point used when deciding allow or deny for the preview.

commandAssignmentTarget.text: Target system, principal, or group this command set applies to.

jumpEnrollmentTtl.text: Hours this one-time Jump enrollment code remains valid (1–720). Shorter is safer.

jumpEnrollmentDescription.text: Optional note so you can tell enrollment codes apart in the audit record.

jumpEnrollmentPool.text: Optional capacity pool for the joining host. Leave empty to use the default pool.

jumpEnrollmentCode.text: One-time enrollment plaintext. Copy now — it cannot be looked up again.

jumpBaseUrl.text: External Jump accept URL (for example http://10.55.0.12:9443). Leave empty for AIC Server local capacity.

remoteAccessFavoritesOnly.text: Visar endast system som du markerat som favoriter i den här webbläsaren.

searchFilter.text: Filters the list as you type. Matches visible labels and common identifiers; clear to show all rows.

quickFilter.text: Quick filter for this grid. Same as search: narrows visible rows without changing saved data.

genericFormField.text: Enter the value for this field. Hover or focus for context from the label and surrounding section.

genericCheckbox.text: Turns this option on or off for the current form.

genericToggle.text: Enables or disables this feature. The nearby label describes the effect.

genericSelect.text: Choose one option from the list for this setting.

emailGraphTenantId.text: Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) tenant ID used for Graph sendMail with modern auth.

emailGraphClientId.text: App registration client ID allowed to send mail as the From mailbox.

emailGraphClientSecret.text: Client secret for the Graph app. Stored as a secret; enter a new value only to replace it.

emailGraphFrom.text: Mailbox UPN used in the Graph users/{UPN}/sendMail path.

emailApiKey.text: API key for this email provider. Stored as a secret; never paste into tickets.

emailFromAddress.text: From address the provider will use on outbound messages.

emailMailgunDomain.text: Mailgun sending domain configured for this organization.

emailMailgunBase.text: Mailgun API base URL (US or EU). Use the region that matches your Mailgun account.

emailSmtpHost.text: SMTP server hostname that accepts outbound mail for this organization.

emailSmtpPort.text: TCP port for SMTP (common values: 587 STARTTLS, 465 TLS, 25 relay).

emailSubject.text: Subject line for this test or encrypted message.

emailCuiPlaintext.text: CUI plaintext placed only in the encrypted attachment — not in the clear body.

emailPassphrase.text: Passphrase that wraps the encrypted CUI payload. Share out of band with the recipient.

emailRecipientCert.text: Recipient S/MIME certificate in PEM form used to encrypt this message.

emailRecipientPgp.text: Recipient OpenPGP public key used to encrypt this message.

messagingProbeLog.text: Read-only step log from the last connectivity or authentication probe. Secrets are never shown.

smsProvider.text: Which SMS send system to use (Twilio, MessageBird, Vonage, Plivo, Telnyx, or SNS).

smsTwilioSid.text: Twilio Account SID for this messaging project.

smsTwilioApiKeySid.text: Twilio API Key SID (preferred over auth token for least privilege).

smsTwilioToken.text: Twilio auth token. Optional when an API Key SID and secret are set.

smsMessagebirdApiKey.text: MessageBird AccessKey used to authenticate API calls.

smsMessagebirdChannel.text: MessageBird Channels API channel ID used for outbound SMS.

smsVonageSecret.text: Vonage (Nexmo) API secret paired with the API key.

smsPlivoAuthId.text: Plivo Auth ID for this account.

smsPlivoToken.text: Plivo Auth Token. Stored as a secret.

smsTelnyxProfile.text: Optional Telnyx messaging profile ID that routes outbound SMS.

smsSnsSecret.text: AWS SNS secret access key. Stored as a secret; pair with the access key id.

elevationOffer.text: Elevation offer (channel and policy package) used when minting a code for this endpoint.

elevationChallengeId.text: Challenge identifier returned by the agent. Paste it to compute a response.

elevationResponse.text: Computed challenge response to paste back into the elevation client.

auditEngagementName.text: Display name for this audit engagement. Shown in lists and the binder.

auditFramework.text: Framework or assessment segment this engagement covers (for example CMMC Level 2).

auditEngagementType.text: Whether this is an internal, customer, or external-firm engagement.

auditFirm.text: Assessment firm record linked to this engagement.

auditFirmName.text: Name of a new assessment firm to create and attach.

auditWindowStart.text: First day of the assessment window (inclusive).

auditWindowEnd.text: Last day of the assessment window (inclusive).

auditRequestUniqueId.text: Stable unique id for this evidence request (often from the assessor tracker).

auditRequestDescription.text: What evidence or artifact the assessor is asking for.

auditOwnerPrincipal.text: Principal UUID responsible for fulfilling this request.

auditFlagReason.text: Why this request is flagged for attention. Stored in the audit trail.

auditEvidenceText.text: Observation or evidence narrative attached to this request.

auditCitationKind.text: Kind of citation (control, procedure, finding, or other source).

auditCitationSource.text: Identifier of the cited source (control id, document id, or ticket).

auditCitationSummary.text: Frozen observation text captured at citation time.

auditCommentThread.text: Which discussion thread receives this comment.

auditCommentBody.text: Comment text posted to the selected thread. Visible to engagement participants.

riskTitle.text: Short title for this risk. Shown in the register and reports.

riskCategory.text: Category used to group related risks (for example access, change, vendor).

riskLikelihood.text: Inherent likelihood before treatment (1–5 or the scale your program uses).

riskImpact.text: Inherent impact before treatment (1–5 or the scale your program uses).

riskTreatmentSummary.text: Plain-language summary of the treatment plan and owners.

riskResidualLikelihood.text: Likelihood remaining after the recorded treatment.

riskResidualImpact.text: Impact remaining after the recorded treatment.

riskNextReview.text: Date the next formal risk review is due.

riskRationale.text: Why this risk is being accepted, closed, or reopened. Required for the audit trail.

riskReopenStatus.text: Status to assign when reopening a closed risk.

riskControlRef.text: Control or safeguard reference linked to this risk.

riskPoamId.text: POA&M item identifier linked to this risk.

eventsWebhookUrl.text: HTTPS URL that receives event webhooks. Must be reachable from this server.

eventsBasicUser.text: Username for HTTP basic authentication to the webhook destination.

eventsDdTags.text: Datadog ddtags string attached to forwarded events.

eventsDestName.text: Operator label for this HTTP event destination.

eventsTypeFilter.text: Comma-separated event type names to forward. Leave empty to use routing defaults.

knownDefaultFilterVendor.text: Filters catalog rows by vendor name.

knownDefaultFilterPlatform.text: Filters catalog rows by platform or OS family.

knownDefaultSearchField.text: Limits catalog search to one column (vendor, platform, OS, username, published password, or service).

knownDefaultSearchQuery.text: Search text applied to the selected catalog field. Leave empty to list every row.

knownDefaultMaskPasswords.text: When on, hides published factory passwords in the grid. Turn off to confirm the documented default.

knownDefaultCustomerCsv.text: Customer-supplied CSV of known-default credential rows to import.

knownDefaultGenPlatform.text: Platform sample used when generating a rotation password example.

knownDefaultProduct.text: Product or appliance name for this known-default credential row.

knownDefaultUsername.text: Default username commonly shipped for this product.

knownDefaultPlatformPattern.text: Platform family this row applies to (linux, windows, network, bmc, ot_plc, or *).

knownDefaultVendor.text: Equipment or software vendor name for this factory-default row.

knownDefaultPublishedPassword.text: Public vendor default password from documentation — not a live endpoint secret.

knownDefaultBannerMatchHint.text: Banner tokens separated by | used to match scan signatures.

knownDefaultNotes.text: Operator notes about this catalog row. Not sent to endpoints as secrets.

knownDefaultEnabled.text: When off, scanners ignore this catalog row.

knownDefaultReloadSource.text: Reloads bundled dictionary rows from the shipped source file on this server.

knownDefaultFetchLatest.text: Downloads the latest redistributable source and merges rows into the catalog.

settingsMitmProxyPort.text: TCP port for the optional diagnostic MITM proxy on this server.

settingsPreferredIdp.text: Identity provider this browser prefers on the logon page (stored per operator).

otScanNetworks.text: IPv4 networks to scan during discovery. Enter one CIDR per line. The first network is used for the next run.

otDiscoveryInterval.text: Minutes between automatic discovery scans when the schedule is enabled.

otRotateTarget.text: Protocol family for password rotation (modbus or opcua). Pick the target type that matches the asset.

otRotateOldPassword.text: Current password on the target. Leave empty to use the password already stored for this asset.

otRotateNewPassword.text: New password to apply on the target after rotation and vault propagation complete.

otBreakGlassReason.text: Business reason for one-time password reveal. Required for audit; at least eight characters.

otBreakGlassPassword.text: One-shot revealed password. Copy if needed, then dismiss — not stored in the browser.

actionCancel.text: Closes without saving changes made in this dialog or form.

actionRefresh.text: Reloads data from the server so the list shows the latest state.

actionBack.text: Returns to the previous page or step.

actionNext.text: Continues to the next step in this wizard or flow.

actionCopy.text: Copies this value to the clipboard.

actionReveal.text: Shows or hides the secret value. Reveals are audited.

actionDownload.text: Downloads this file or export to your computer.

actionUpload.text: Chooses a file to upload to the server.

actionSearch.text: Runs or focuses search for this list.

actionFilter.text: Opens or clears filters for this view.

genericText.text: Plain text for this field. Use concise operator-facing wording.

actionHelp.text: Shows help for this page or control.

demoLicenseBannerCancel.text: Hide this demo license notice for the rest of this browser session.

demoLicenseBannerRequest.text: Open disconnected licensing to request or install a purchased license.

licensingSiteToken.text: Opaque site token for AIC License Management. It does not include host names or IP addresses. Copy it, then paste it on the Activate page.

licensingPackage.text: Paste the signed license package or choose the file you received. Import replaces the key now on this server.

defaultPwSave.text: Saves the enclave default password policy.

regulatoryStandard.text: Regulatory standard selected for this disclosure or assessment step.

settingsEnvelopeField.text: Value written into the settings envelope for this key.

trainingFrameworkToggle.text: When on, this framework is included in training coverage reporting.

frameworkCoverageSwitch.text: Includes or excludes this framework row from the coverage summary.

gdprRopaKind.text: Controller rows follow Article 30(1); processor rows follow Article 30(2).

gdprRopaActivityName.text: Short name for this processing activity in the register.

gdprRopaControllerName.text: Legal name of the controller responsible for this activity.

gdprRopaControllerContact.text: Contact details for the controller (privacy inbox or DPO).

gdprRopaJointController.text: Name of any joint controller, if processing is jointly determined.

gdprRopaJointControllerContact.text: Contact details for the joint controller.

gdprRopaProcessorName.text: Name of the processor acting on the controller's instructions.

gdprRopaDpoName.text: Name of the data protection officer when one is designated.

gdprRopaDpoContact.text: Contact details for the data protection officer.

gdprRopaPurposes.text: Why personal data is processed for this activity.

gdprRopaDataSubjects.text: Who the data is about (for example employees, customers, or visitors).

gdprRopaPersonalData.text: What kinds of personal data are processed.

gdprRopaRecipients.text: Who receives the data (teams, vendors, or authorities).

gdprRopaTransfers.text: Whether data is transferred outside the EEA and to which countries.

gdprRopaTransferSafeguards.text: Safeguards relied on for third-country transfers.

gdprRopaRetention.text: How long each category of data is kept.

gdprRopaSecurity.text: General technical and organizational measures that protect this processing.

gdprRopaReviewCycle.text: How often this register row must be reviewed (days).

gdprRopaReview.text: Record that this register row was reviewed on schedule.

gdprRopaExport.text: Download the active register as JSON for supervisory authority review.

gdprDpiaTitle.text: Name of the processing operation being assessed.

gdprDpiaStatus.text: Where this DPIA is in the workflow (threshold, assessment, DPO review, and so on).

gdprDpiaThreshold.text: Explain why a DPIA is required or why it is not.

gdprDpiaArt353Triggers.text: Which Article 35(3) criteria apply, if any.

gdprDpiaNecessity.text: Explain whether the processing is necessary and proportionate.

gdprDpiaRisk.text: Explain risks to the rights and freedoms of people.

gdprDpiaMitigation.text: List measures chosen to reduce or remove those risks.

gdprDpiaDpoAdvice.text: Record advice from the data protection officer when one is designated.

gdprDpiaPriorConsultationNotes.text: Record consultation with the supervisory authority under Article 36.

gdprDpiaPriorConsultationAt.text: When prior consultation with the authority took place (UTC).

gdprDpiaDecision.text: Final outcome of the DPIA workflow.

gdprDpiaDecisionReason.text: Plain-language reason for the DPIA outcome.

gdprDsrIntake.text: Open a new data-subject request and start the one-month response clock.

gdprDsrRight.text: Which Chapter III right the person asked to use.

gdprDsrStatus.text: Where this request is in intake, verification, fulfillment, or closure.

gdprDsrVerifyIdentity.text: Record Article 12(6) identity verification before handing over personal data.

gdprDsrVerifyMethod.text: How the requester proved who they are (ID check, account challenge, and so on).

gdprDsrVerifyEvidence.text: What evidence you relied on — kept in the append-only event ledger.

gdprDsrRefuseVerification.text: Record when verification failed or must be paused — closes the request as refused.

gdprDsrWorkforceLink.text: Link to a workforce roster row when the requester is in scope; leave empty for external data subjects.

gdprDpiaThresholdRequired.text: Record whether Article 35 requires a DPIA for this processing.

gdprDpiaPriorConsultationRequired.text: Mark when residual high risk requires Article 36 prior consultation.

gdprDsrLocated.text: Where relevant data was found and which systems hold it.

gdprDsrDelivery.text: What was actually sent or done for the requester.

gdprDsrDecision.text: Final decision and plain-language reason, including any exemption relied on.

gdprDsrExtend.text: Record a two-month extension with reason when the request is complex.
